sigma_floor: log(1.001), dimensionless one-observation log return, borrowed from original CP economic 0.1% scale floor. It is a numerical-economic convention, not exchange tick size, true volatility or fitted success cutoff. No historical adjustment. All scale values reported; H is not standardized or trained across stocks and health=1/(1+H) is bounded.
signal_year: Reindex every original entry by signal_day year. Main terminal-closed-by-endpoint and explicit 2022-year-end subset separate; also report cross-year signal vs entry count, unclosed, unknown, partial warm.
date_cluster: Per signal year, terminal-closed, common finite health/plain_health/PVR cases. Date clusters are fixed nonoverlapping 20 common-calendar trading-day blocks, not per stock or transaction independence. 1000 cluster resamples seed20261106; AUC and paired differences versus plain_health/PVR, descriptive percentile95 intervals only. 2026 incomplete and few clusters explicitly not annual validation. No parameter selection.
major_periods: Signal dates 2024-09-19..2024-10-08 and 2026-01-01..2026-03-31. All original firsts, original fully closed net winners/losers, and original complete60 posthoc big60 subset. Report health and nominal research probe risk reduction, unknown, original unclosed, mature60 counts. This is not complete original-signal early capture, no candidate/rank replacement or share sizing; no causal missed trades or changed PnL claimed.
no_new_cutoffs: No health cut, quartile trading groups or fitted thresholds. Winner/loser labels use preexisting net0-to0 outcomes solely for description. No source or signal recomputation beyond the same frozen state extraction.
